postCreateCommand: d=$(mktemp -d) && printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$d/bootstrap-aicoding.sh" && chmod 0700 "$d/bootstrap-aicoding.sh" && "$d/bootstrap-aicoding.sh" --profile container; rc=$?; rm -rf -- "$d"; exit $rc
postStartCommand: runtime="$(readlink -f "${AICODING_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.local/share/aicoding}/current/aicoding" 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$runtime" ] && [ -r "$runtime/on-start.sh" ]; then bash "$runtime/on-start.sh" </dev/null; else echo "WARN: persistent tooling is not enrolled; verified bootstrap enrollment required" >&2; fi
